title: Canonical coordinate-line adjunction and conjugacy maps
statement: For the finite coefficient datum [def-pur-conventions], or generically a finite commutative ring A annihilated by a positive integer N, form the standard affine-line chart and projective compactification [def-sbc-affine-space], [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change], [def-amb-etale-compact-support]. Let W be the restriction of the shifted ordinary projective Tate line [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback]. Define G as inverse image tensor W and identify the right side of the actual composite affine-trace adjunction [def-amb-affine-trace-construction], [lem-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-adjunction], [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction] with G by the canonical tensor and composition comparisons. For a Noetherian base T with N invertible on T, transport that adjunction; define integration as projective trace after direct image of the open counit, and the canonical coefficient-first compact projection arrow [lem-weil-finite-compact-projection-formula]. Define its counit-normalization predicate. Compare G to the ordinary compact-support right adjoint [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image] by conjugating the identity left functor [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate]; record the counit-preservation and transpose predicates. In the published affine-line source coordinates [def-pur-affine-line-purity-source], [def-pur-affine-line-purity-coordinate-maps], define the compared conjugate using the specified source comparison, comparison pullback of this conjugate, the actual site-comparison unit, and the supplied realization isomorphism [lem-pur-vector-integration-site-comparison]. All constructions use the canonical maps and the specified standard compactification; the attached definitions give the literal formulas.

proof.text: For projection, write the canonical compactification projection as its proper and open components using Etale.projectionMapOfCompactification_app_app. The compactification pullback comparison is the inverse pullback compositor by Etale.leftDerivedUpperStarCompactificationIso_eq. For the standard chart the middle scheme, open map, proper map and commutativity equation are the literal projective-line data. Keep the two symmetry factors and all other constructions unchanged. This is an expansion of the specified canonical map, not a new projection.
